freeze_policy: Immutable membership, mutable per-ID outcomes; new scheduled findings MUST NOT append IDs or block snapshot closure
invariant_rules: Do not add a 51st family to this fixed historical batch
Upcoming hourly task outputs/new source discoveries go only to separately labeled NEW_RESULTS_INBOX; only genuine delta events, not duplicate old count
An issue may update status/evidence for a frozen ID without changing denominator
Local-only gates are assigned to the Codex local validation work package by PR and require independent actual exit/status/hash evidence
Blocked for external credentials, production Windows, maintainer history, or private gold remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, not passed or a fabricated test
Once all 50 have an auditable disposition, close historical triage even if continuing engineering release tasks outside historical batch; NEVER equate triage with release
No paid APIs/Actions runner, no Work quota, no auto merging PRs, no user private data copy, no production PLC or SQLite changes
